<h2><span data-contrast="none"><span class="TextRun SCXW253142866 BCX0" lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW253142866 BCX0">Curved Tension Fabric Display FAQs</span></span></span></h2>
<p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Can I print on both sides of the fabric display?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":259}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Yes, you can print on both sides of the graphic. Select "Front and Back” as your Printed Side.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":259}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":259}"> </span></p>
<p><strong><span data-contrast="none">How many LED lights can I add to the display?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":259}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Y</span><span data-contrast="none">ou</span><span data-contrast="none"> can add 2 pieces of LED lights to an order of the graphic with the frame. The LED lights are attached to the frame. </span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":259}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":259}"> </span></p>
<p><strong><span data-contrast="none">How soon can I receive my curved tension fabric display?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":259}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">The shipping for your display begins after the </span><span data-contrast="none">4-business</span><span data-contrast="none">-</span><span data-contrast="none">day</span><span data-contrast="none"> printing time. To find out how soon you can receive your order, select “Estimate Shipping and Delivery” below the online calculator and input your ZIP code. Several arrival dates will appear based on your location.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":259}"> </span></p>            </div>
